Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 30, 2026

1. Introduction

Work Pro ("we", "our", or "us") is a freelance marketplace built on Pi Network. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our application through the Pi Browser. It applies to every user of the platform.

Key point: Work Pro is a neutral venue that connects clients and freelancers. We are not a party to the contracts users form with each other, not an employer, not an agent, and not a payment institution. Pi transactions are executed by the Pi Network, not by us.

2. Data Controller

The data controller for personal data processed through the platform is the operator of Work Pro. Contact for all privacy matters: divashnov@gmail.com, or the in-app chat feature.

3. Information We Collect

3.1 Provided by the Pi Network SDK at sign-in

  • Pi Username — your unique public identifier on our platform
  • Pi User ID (UID) — a unique identifier provided by Pi Network for authentication
  • An access token used solely to verify your identity against the Pi Platform API

We never receive or store your Pi passphrase, private keys, wallet seed, or Pi account password. We cannot access your Pi wallet.

3.2 Provided by you

  • Profile data: display name, bio, skills, portfolio, avatar image, availability status
  • An optional contact email address, if you choose to add one to your profile
  • Job postings, proposals and applications
  • Chat messages and file attachments you exchange with other users
  • Reviews and ratings you leave
  • Dispute submissions and their supporting text

3.3 Generated by your use of the platform

  • Payment metadata: Pi payment identifiers, amounts, status, transaction IDs (public on the Pi blockchain)
  • Escrow and milestone records, platform fee amounts
  • Connects balance and purchase history
  • Technical and security logs, including your IP address, timestamps and request metadata — used for rate limiting, fraud and abuse prevention. IP addresses are also recorded in administrative audit logs when moderation actions are taken.
  • Push notification tokens, if you enable notifications

4. Information We Do NOT Collect

We do not collect:

  • Phone numbers
  • Physical addresses
  • Government-issued IDs (KYC is handled entirely by Pi Network — we only see a verified/not-verified flag)
  • Bank account, card or other financial account details
  • Your Pi wallet passphrase, private keys or password
  • Third-party advertising or cross-site tracking cookies

We use browser local storage for your session token, language preference, theme setting and cached interface state. This is necessary for the app to function and is not used for advertising or cross-site tracking.

5. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR Art. 6)

  • Contract performance — account, profile, jobs, messaging, escrow and payment records: processing is necessary to provide the service you requested.
  • Legitimate interests — security logging, rate limiting, fraud and abuse prevention, aggregated product analytics, and enforcing our Terms.
  • Consent — push notifications and any optional communications. You may withdraw consent at any time.
  • Legal obligation — responding to lawful requests from competent authorities and retaining records where law requires it.

6. How We Use Your Information

  • Authenticate you and display your public profile to other users
  • Match freelancers with job opportunities and power search and filtering
  • Process Pi payments for connects purchases and manage escrow between clients and freelancers
  • Calculate and collect the platform fee on completed transactions
  • Enable chat communication between parties
  • Deliver in-app and push notifications about activity relevant to you
  • Investigate disputes, fraud and Terms violations
  • Improve the platform using aggregated, non-identifying statistics

We do not use your data for automated decision-making that produces legal effects concerning you, and we do not profile you for advertising.

7. What Other Users Can See

Your username, avatar, bio, skills, portfolio, availability, ratings, reviews and public job postings are visible to other users. Do not place sensitive personal information — home address, identity documents, financial account details — in these fields. Messages are visible to the participants of the conversation and, where a dispute is raised, to the administrator resolving it.

8. Data Sharing

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data. We share it only with:

  • Pi Network — for authentication and to submit, approve and complete Pi payments. Pi Network's own privacy policy governs that processing.
  • Infrastructure providers — our hosting and managed database provider, acting as processors under contract, solely to run the platform.
  • Competent authorities — where we are legally compelled, or where disclosure is necessary to prevent imminent harm or investigate serious abuse.
  • A successor entity — if the platform is transferred, merged or acquired, subject to this policy continuing to apply.

Pi blockchain transactions are inherently public. Amounts and wallet addresses recorded on-chain are outside our control and cannot be deleted by us.

9. Data Storage and Security

Your data is stored securely on our servers. We apply industry-standard measures: HTTPS/TLS encryption in transit, hashed session tokens, scoped administrative access, rate limiting, input validation, and audit logging of privileged actions. No system is perfectly secure. You are responsible for keeping your Pi Network credentials confidential; anyone controlling your Pi account can access your Work Pro account.

10. Data Retention

  • Account and profile data — for as long as your account is active
  • Jobs, escrow, payment and fee records — retained after account deletion to support dispute resolution and to satisfy accounting and tax obligations
  • Chat messages — for the life of the account
  • Security and audit logs — up to 12 months
  • Backups — rolling, overwritten within 90 days

After account deletion we retain only what law or the defence of legal claims requires, in de-identified form where feasible. Anonymised analytics data may be retained indefinitely.

11. Your Rights (GDPR Art. 15–22)

Subject to applicable law, you may request:

  • Access — a copy of the personal data we hold about you
  • Rectification — correction of inaccurate data (most fields are self-editable in the app)
  • Erasure — deletion of your account and associated data
  • Restriction — that we pause processing while a dispute is resolved
  • Portability — your data in a structured, machine-readable format
  • Objection — to processing based on our legitimate interests
  • Withdrawal of consent — at any time, without affecting prior lawful processing

Send requests via the in-app chat or to divashnov@gmail.com. We respond within 30 days. We may ask you to verify control of your Pi account before acting on a request. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority.

12. Children's Privacy

Our service is not intended for and may not be used by anyone under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If we learn that a minor has created an account, we will delete it.

13. Data Breach

In the event of a data breach affecting your personal information, we will notify affected users and the relevant supervisory authority without undue delay and, where required, within 72 hours of becoming aware of it.

14. International Transfers

Our hosting and database providers may process data outside your country of residence, including outside the European Economic Area. Where that occurs we rely on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or an adequacy decision as the transfer mechanism.

15. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify users of any significant changes through the app. The "Last updated" date above always reflects the current version.

16. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, or wish to exercise your rights, contact us via the in-app chat or at divashnov@gmail.com. See also our Terms of Service.
